messages:
Maya: Quick sync — need guardrails for upcoming marketplace private offers that bundle Reserved GPU + HW appliance. Goal: pricing floor, renewal uplift rules, SI integration credits.
Jonas: +1. What's the ask from partner side? any % targets?
Maya: Partner asked for 25% off list if customer commits 12mo reserved capacity. They also want a hardware rebate tied to SKU conversion.
Priya: 25% seems steep. Finance suggests max 18% for combined discounts when including HW credits. We can layer credits: up to 10% upfront (promo), then 8% commit discount on renewal if consumption hit.
Evan: Legal note: private offers need to include explicit SKU mapping and renewal trigger language. I'll draft an amendment template. Also watch for marketplace fee recoup.
Renee: Product: we need to ensure Dedicated customers can pin model variants regardless of private-offer routing. Also must expose metering dimensions for the commit (tokens vs gpu-hours).
Jonas: For sales ops: can we do a two-stage price: initial private offer with promo credits, then a renewal SKU at a slightly higher list but with consumption thresholds for deeper discounts?
Priya: Yes — propose: Promo credit = $X (one-time), Commit discount = 12% at 12mo consumption floor, 18% if 12mo + usage growth >=20% YoY. That caps total ~25% at best.
Maya: Sounds reasonable. Can we translate to marketplace fields? e.g., privateOffer.priceAdjustment + lineItem credit? Any constraints from marketplace listing teams?
Evan: Marketplaces vary. Azure/GCP allow one-time credits + recurring price discounts; AWS private offers use discounted unit price. ops-bot: /marketplace-check azure,gcp,aws -> returns differences.
ops-bot: azure: supports invoice credit + recurring price; gcp: supports one-time promo and recurring adjustment; aws: supports private offer discounted unit price only.
Renee: Action items: Evan - draft amendment language by EOD Thurs; Priya - model P&L scenarios with 3 account sizes; Jonas - prepare sales playbook bullets; Maya - coordinate partner comms and confirm partner accepts layered structure.
Jonas: I'll include a sample playbook snippet: `Offer structure: [Promo credit] + [12mo commit discount threshold] + [renewal escalator]`. Will share by tomorrow.
Priya: I'll add sensitivity for hardware rebate: treat rebate as contra-revenue (cap at $200k) and amortize over 12 months.
Maya: Thanks team. If no blockers I'll run partner call Friday 11am PT. RSVP in thread.
Jonas: RSVP :thumbsup:
Evan: RSVP
Priya: RSVP
Renee: RSVP
